scope: Keep a tabbed desktop dock group contiguous in the saved three-region order when the canvas toolbar is dragged before/after the physical group track.

source_control.runtime_commit_message: fix(editor): move tabbed dock as one canvas drag group

gap_and_fix.verified_gap: When the canvas was dragged before/after a tabbed group, sorting DOM regions by left coordinate included the inactive display:none dock at x=0; the saved dockOrder could therefore remain unchanged or split the two panel IDs around the canvas.
gap_and_fix.red_reproduction: Native Chromium drag from canvas toolbar to the trailing edge of the visible left-side tab group failed: actual order left-canvas-right, expected the contiguous group order left-right-canvas.
gap_and_fix.fix: Tabbed drops use the validated saved three-region order. A canvas-source drop treats the two dock IDs as one logical cluster and inserts the canvas before the first or after the last dock ID, preserving the group side and panel internal order. Cache-busted shell URL changed to 20261105-tabbed-canvas-drag-cluster.
gap_and_fix.no_page_write: The browser fixture recorded zero Page Model/Save/Publish/renderer requests.

coverage.browser: Real Chromium through Playwright locator.dragTo native mouse input.
assertions: group physical side and mode are preserved
dock rectangles do not overlap canvas
one undo step restores old order and redo reapplies new order
new order reloads with tab group intact
zero page model or publish requests
